title: The 5W Path to God's Will
hook: Stop waiting for the full map - take the next faithful step.
script: Stop waiting for the full map - take the next faithful step. God usually guides by lamp, not floodlight. Open the Word: Does Scripture light this path? Psalm 119:105. Seek Wisdom: invite two mature voices to weigh in. Proverbs 11:14. Check Willingness: am I surrendered to whatever God says? Romans 12:2. Notice your Wiring: gifts and holy desires point to service. 1 Peter 4:10. Watch the Windows: doors that open or close like in Acts 16. If four agree and one resists, pause and pray. Then act on the smallest clear step today. Peace grows with obedience, not perfect certainty.

title: When Silence Becomes Direction
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. I begged God for a calling and waited for a thunderbolt. Nothing. So I took one faithful step: I wrote a note to encourage a friend. Then I volunteered one hour. Then I applied for a small role I felt unqualified for. Some doors shut, some swung open. Months later I looked back and saw a line: Word kept nudging love and service, wise mentors confirmed it, my heart softened in surrender, my gifts fit, and circumstances aligned. One step became a path. Do not chase a blueprint. Practice obedience, and the road appears.

title: A 10 Minute Next Step With God
script: You may be overthinking this. Try a 10 minute will of God check. Set a timer. Two minutes in the Word: read Psalm 119:105 and one passage about your decision. Two minutes for Wisdom: message two trusted believers and ask for one concern and one green light. Two minutes for Willingness: pray Romans 12:2, surrender outcomes. Two minutes for Wiring: list gifts, burdens, joy. Two minutes for Windows: note open doors, constraints, and timing like Acts 16. Circle the common thread and write one smallest step you can do in the next 24 hours. Clarity often follows movement, not analysis.
